notes: Two routes, joined by «وحدثنا» and not by «ح»: the second names «عاصم، عن زر» and then the same saying follows, so both routes close at Zar and share the tail (rule 4)
«قال سألت أبى بن كعب» makes Zar the asker, so Ubayy is the next link (rule 5); the Prophet is the end of the chain and is not written
«أخاك ابن مسعود» is a remark on what Ibn Mas'ud says, not a route, and is not written
